thread:
Nina Patel: Hey — quick question: I accepted the orientation invite but in my calendar it shows the event at 2:00 PM (my local IST) instead of 9:00 AM PT. Will there be a recording if I can't make the live? Also I don't see a meeting link in the event details, just 'See event details'.
Aisha - People Ops: Welcome, Nina! The live session is 9:00 AM PT / 17:00 GMT / 22:30 IST. We always record and upload the recording to the onboarding Drive folder + post the clip in #new-hires. I'll confirm the link shortly. :tada:
Julia - Onboarding: Looks like GCal sometimes hides the conferencing link if the organizer account isn't visible to a guest address. I just re-shared the event from our onboarding@redwood.com account — check in ~2 minutes. I'm also adding a backup Zoom link and breakout room notes. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/j/123456789
Devon: FWIW if someone adds a personal email it can behave weirdly. @Matt can you check calendar share perms for nina.patel@personal.email? Also to avoid confusion we'll put multiple TZ labels in the event description.
Matt - IT: Checked — invite was sent from onboarding@redwood.com but Nina's RSVP was from a personal address that wasn't in our org directory, so Meet was suppressed. I re-sent the invite to nina.patel@personal.email and toggled the conferencing link to attach. If you still don't see it, open the event on the web and click 'More actions > View guest list' to confirm your address is included. I also enabled 'Guests can see invite details'.
calendar-bot: Event updated: "Redwood New Hire Orientation" — recording enabled. Zoom + Meet links attached. Recording will be posted within 24h after the session.
Aisha - People Ops: :wave: Welcome again! Recording will be uploaded to the onboarding Drive folder and we'll clip highlights for folks in very different time zones. If you need the raw recording earlier for timezone reasons DM me and we can arrange a quick 1:1 recap.
Nina Patel: Thanks — I can see the Zoom link now. One more q: will slides be shared ahead of time? I like to skim before joining.
Julia - Onboarding: Yes — slides will be uploaded about 1 hour before the session to the calendar event and the onboarding Drive folder. Added a short note in the event summary: "Slides uploaded 1h prior."
Nina Patel: Perfect, thanks everyone! :)
Aisha - People Ops: If anyone else is seeing timezone/link weirdness drop your city and email here and I'll post a conversion table and resend invites as needed.
